def.short: feeling fear because something might hurt you or something bad might happen
def.long: Feeling fear because you think something might hurt you or something bad might happen. You are scared of something, or scared to do something.

grammar.pattern: be scared of sth / be scared to do sth

examples.en: Ece is scared of thunder.
examples.tr: Ece gök gürültüsünden korkuyor.

examples.en: I was scared when all the lights suddenly went off.
examples.tr: Bütün ışıklar birden sönünce korktum.

examples.en: Tom was too scared to go on the big roller coaster, so he waited for us at the exit.
examples.tr: Tom büyük hız trenine binemeyecek kadar korktu, bu yüzden bizi çıkışta bekledi.

tr.note: Korkan kişi 'scared', korkutan şey 'scary' olur: 'I'm scared of this film. It's scary.' 'afraid' ile aynı anlamdadır ama 'a scared child' denir, 'an afraid child' denmez.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'korkuyorum' bir fiil olduğu için 'am' atlanıyor. İngilizcede 'scared' bir sıfattır ve 'be' ister. 'I scared' 'ben (birini) korkuttum' demektir.

quiz.cloze: Selin screamed and ran out of the room because she was ______ of the spider.

def.short: making you feel afraid or nervous
def.long: Making you feel afraid or nervous. A film, a story, a place or a situation can be like this, for example a dark street at night.

grammar.pattern: a scary film / it's scary to do sth

examples.en: This film is too scary for children.
examples.tr: Bu film çocuklar için fazla korkutucu.

examples.en: Driving in snow for the first time was a bit scary.
examples.tr: İlk kez karda araba sürmek biraz korkutucuydu.

examples.en: Diego told us a scary story about an empty old house, and nobody wanted to turn off the light.
examples.tr: Diego bize boş, eski bir ev hakkında korkunç bir hikâye anlattı ve kimse ışığı kapatmak istemedi.

tr.note: 'scary' korku veren şeyi anlatır: film, hikâye, karanlık bir sokak. Korkan kişi için 'scared' kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: I'm scary when I'm home alone at night.
mistakes.right: I'm scared when I'm home alone at night.
mistakes.why: 'Korkuyorum' demek isterken 'scary' seçiliyor. 'I'm scary' 'Ben korkunç biriyim' demektir; korkan kişi 'scared' olur.

quiz.cloze: I closed my eyes during the film because it was too ______.

def.short: happy and satisfied about something that happened or that someone did
def.long: Happy and satisfied because something good happened or because someone did something well. It is a little more formal than 'happy'.

grammar.pattern: pleased with sth / pleased to do sth

examples.en: Pleased to meet you.
examples.tr: Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum.

examples.en: Murat's boss was very pleased with his report.
examples.tr: Murat'ın patronu raporundan çok memnun kaldı.

examples.en: We were pleased to hear that our flight was on time.
examples.tr: Uçuşumuzun zamanında olduğunu duyunca sevindik.

tr.note: Bir şeyden memnunsan 'pleased with' denir: 'I'm pleased with my new phone.' Tanışırken 'Pleased to meet you.' kullanılır; buradaki kelime 'please' değil, 'pleased' olur.

mistakes.wrong: I'm pleased from my new job.
mistakes.right: I'm pleased with my new job.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki '-den memnun' eki 'from' diye çevriliyor. İngilizcede 'pleased with' denir.
'please' ile 'pleased' sesçe çok yakın olduğu için sondaki 'd' düşüyor. Tanışırken 'memnun' anlamındaki 'pleased' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The teacher was ______ with Burak's homework, so she gave him a gold star.

def.short: making you feel happy and full of energy because something good is happening
def.long: Making you feel happy and full of energy, often because something is new, fast or full of action. A match, a trip or a new job can be like this.

grammar.pattern: an exciting match / it's exciting to do sth

examples.en: What an exciting day!
examples.tr: Ne heyecan verici bir gün!

examples.en: Laura's first week at her new job was really exciting.
examples.tr: Laura'nın yeni işindeki ilk haftası çok heyecan vericiydi.

examples.en: Yuki finds learning a new language exciting, so she practices every day.
examples.tr: Yuki yeni bir dil öğrenmeyi heyecan verici buluyor, bu yüzden her gün pratik yapıyor.

tr.note: Heyecan veren şey 'exciting', heyecanlanan kişi 'excited' olur: 'The match was exciting, and the fans were excited.'

mistakes.wrong: I'm so exciting about my new bike.
mistakes.right: I'm so excited about my new bike.
mistakes.why: Türkçede hem kişi hem şey için 'heyecanlı' denir. İngilizcede heyecanlanan kişi 'excited' olur; 'I'm exciting' 'Ben heyecan verici biriyim' demektir.

quiz.cloze: The last minutes of the game were very ______, and all the fans were shouting.

def.short: very good or surprising in a way that makes you feel happy
def.long: Very good or very surprising in a way that you like. People often use it to talk about food, places, views and people's skills.

examples.en: The view from the top is amazing.
examples.tr: Tepeden manzara harika.

examples.en: Derya makes amazing chocolate cake.
examples.tr: Derya harika çikolatalı kek yapıyor.

examples.en: We watched an amazing sunset on our last evening in Bodrum.
examples.tr: Bodrum'daki son akşamımızda muhteşem bir gün batımı izledik.

tr.note: Hayran kalan kişi 'amazed' olur: 'I was amazed by the view.' Güzel ya da şaşırtıcı olan şey 'amazing' olur.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'çok harika' denir. 'amazing' zaten 'çok iyi' demek olduğu için 'very' ile pek kullanılmaz; 'really' ya da 'absolutely' daha doğaldır.

quiz.cloze: Thanks for dinner, the food was ______! Can I have the recipe?

def.short: worried and nervous because you think something bad might happen
def.long: Worried and nervous because you think something bad might happen. It is a little stronger and more serious than 'worried'.

examples.en: Kerem gets anxious before exams.
examples.tr: Kerem sınavlardan önce kaygılanıyor.

examples.en: Aisha was anxious about her first day at the new school.
examples.tr: Aisha yeni okuldaki ilk günü için kaygılıydı.

examples.en: Ozan always feels a bit anxious on planes, so he listens to music during the flight.
examples.tr: Ozan uçakta hep biraz kaygılanır, bu yüzden uçuş boyunca müzik dinler.

tr.note: 'worried' ve 'nervous' ile anlamı yakındır; 'anxious' biraz daha güçlü ve ciddidir. Okunuşu 'enkşıs' gibidir; ortadaki 'x' /kş/ sesi verir.

mistakes.why: Türkçedeki '-den kaygılanmak' 'from' diye çevriliyor. İngilizcede 'anxious about' denir.

quiz.cloze: Ben couldn't sleep the night before his driving test. He was very ______.

def.short: very surprised, usually by something bad that you did not expect
def.long: Very surprised, usually by something bad or strange that you did not expect at all. It is much stronger than 'surprised'.

grammar.pattern: be shocked by sth / be shocked to see / hear

examples.en: I was shocked to see the mess in the kitchen.
examples.tr: Mutfaktaki dağınıklığı görünce şok oldum.

examples.en: We were shocked to hear that the little café was closing after 40 years.
examples.tr: 40 yıllık o küçük kafenin kapanacağını duyunca şok olduk.

examples.en: Tom looked shocked when his old school friend walked into the office as his new boss.
examples.tr: Eski okul arkadaşı yeni patronu olarak ofise girince Tom şok olmuş görünüyordu.

tr.note: Şok olan kişi 'shocked', şok eden şey 'shocking' olur: 'The news was shocking. We were shocked.'

mistakes.wrong: I shocked when I saw the bill.
mistakes.right: I was shocked when I saw the bill.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'şok oldum' bir fiil gibi kurulduğu için 'was' atlanıyor. 'I shocked' 'ben (birini) şok ettim' demektir; doğrusu 'I was shocked'.

quiz.cloze: Murat was so ______ by the price of the tickets that he almost dropped his phone.

def.long: Extremely angry, much more than just 'angry'. You are this with a person, or about a situation.

grammar.pattern: furious with sb / furious about sth

examples.en: Dad was furious when he saw the broken window.
examples.tr: Babam kırık camı görünce öfkeden deliye döndü.

examples.en: Ece was furious with her brother for reading her diary.
examples.tr: Ece, günlüğünü okuduğu için kardeşine çok kızgındı.

examples.en: The passengers were furious because the flight was six hours late and nobody told them why.
examples.tr: Uçuş altı saat rötar yaptığı ve kimse nedenini söylemediği için yolcular çok öfkeliydi.

tr.note: 'angry' kelimesinin çok daha güçlü hâlidir. Yazılışı ve sesi 'curious' (meraklı) kelimesine benzer; karıştırma.

mistakes.wrong: She was furious to me because I was late.
mistakes.right: She was furious with me because I was late.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'bana kızgın' kalıbındaki '-e' eki 'to' diye çevriliyor. İngilizcede kişiye 'furious with' denir.

quiz.cloze: Laura was ______ when her neighbor parked in front of her garage again.

def.long: Very unhappy and uncomfortable, often because you are ill, cold, wet or tired. Bad weather or a bad day can also be described this way.

examples.en: Burak has a cold and feels miserable.
examples.tr: Burak soğuk algınlığı geçiriyor ve kendini berbat hissediyor.

examples.en: I was miserable on the long bus ride with no air conditioning.
examples.tr: Klimasız uzun otobüs yolculuğunda perişan oldum.

examples.en: It rained every day of our camping trip, and we were wet and miserable.
examples.tr: Kamp gezimizin her günü yağmur yağdı, sırılsıklam ve perişan olduk.

tr.note: Hava için de kullanılır: 'miserable weather' (berbat, kasvetli hava). 'sad' ve 'unhappy' kelimelerinden daha güçlüdür.

quiz.cloze: Ozan has a bad cold, it's raining, and he has to work all weekend. He feels ______.

def.short: upset because someone said or did something rude or unkind to you
def.long: Upset and a little angry because you think someone was rude to you or did not respect you, often because of something they said.

grammar.pattern: be offended by sth / feel offended

examples.en: I hope you're not offended.
examples.tr: Umarım alınmamışsındır.

examples.en: Derya was offended because nobody asked her opinion at the meeting.
examples.tr: Toplantıda kimse fikrini sormadığı için Derya alındı.

examples.en: Sam made a joke about Aisha's cooking, and she was a little offended.
examples.tr: Sam, Aisha'nın yemekleriyle ilgili şaka yaptı ve Aisha biraz alındı.

tr.note: Alınan kişi 'offended' olur. Kırıcı, saldırgan söz ya da şakaya 'offensive' denir: 'an offensive joke'.

mistakes.wrong: She was offended from my joke.
mistakes.right: She was offended by my joke.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki '-den alınmak' kalıbı 'from' diye çevriliyor. İngilizcede 'offended by' denir.

quiz.cloze: Diego didn't mean to be rude, but Zeynep was ______ by his comment about her haircut.

def.short: feeling happy and emotional because someone did something kind for you
def.long: Feeling happy and emotional, sometimes almost crying, because someone was kind to you or did something thoughtful.

grammar.pattern: be touched by sth / be touched that…

examples.en: I was really touched by your message.
examples.tr: Mesajına çok duygulandım.

examples.en: Grandma was touched when the kids made her a birthday card.
examples.tr: Çocuklar ona doğum günü kartı yapınca büyükannem duygulandı.

examples.en: Sam was touched that his neighbors looked after his cat while he was away.
examples.tr: Sam, kendisi yokken kedisine komşularının bakmasına duygulandı.

tr.note: Bu anlamda 'touched' hep güzel bir duygudur. Türkçedeki 'sözü bana dokundu' (kırıldım) anlamı yoktur; o durumda 'I was hurt' ya da 'I was offended' denir. Duygulandıran şeye 'touching' denir.

quiz.cloze: When the class sang for her on her last day, the teacher was so ______ that she almost cried.

def.short: thinking that someone or something is very good, so that you admire them
def.long: Thinking that someone or something is very good, clever or skillful, so that you admire them. You are impressed by or with someone.

examples.en: I'm impressed. Your English is very good!
examples.tr: Etkilendim. İngilizcen çok iyi!

examples.en: Kerem's parents were impressed by his school report.
examples.tr: Kerem'in ailesi karnesinden etkilendi.

examples.en: The judges were so impressed with Yuki's dance that they gave her a perfect score.
examples.tr: Jüri Yuki'nin dansından o kadar etkilendi ki ona tam puan verdi.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'etkilendim' iki anlama gelir: birinin başarısını beğendiysen 'impressed', bir iyilik karşısında duygulandıysan 'touched' denir. Etkileyici olan şeye 'impressive' denir.

mistakes.right: I was impressed by the film.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'filmden etkilendim' kelime kelime çevriliyor: 'was' atlanıyor, '-den' de 'from' oluyor. Doğrusu 'I was impressed by'. 'I impressed' 'ben (birini) etkiledim' demektir.

quiz.cloze: Everyone was ______ by Zeynep's guitar playing. She learned to play in only one year!
